profile.headline: IT Software Engineer at Micron Technology
profile.summary:
Love working with Web Technologies building applications that function properly and look good. I've focused on C# as my language of choice and I'm continually working at improving both my coding standards and my knowledge with a desire to build elegant code that is easy to maintain. I've also worked on native mobile applications using Xamarin to build for both iOS and Android.

Main Languages: C#, Javascript, jQuery, CSS3, HTML5

positions.title: Tech Lead / Software Engineer
positions.description: Web and Mobile development using C#, Xamarin, jQuery, jQuery Mobile, and other technologies.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Regrettably I no longer work for Unity due to their need to preserve cash and the company. My time there was short and sweet.

positions.title: QA/Software Development
positions.description:
CRI Advantage is one of the largest IT Consulting firms in the Northwest. During this project our team was tasked with converting a Visual Foxpro application to a MVC .Net application.

As a QA/Software Development Engineer, my responsibilities are:

Create Integrated tests for custom web applications
Maintain Continuous Integration build server
Catalog and maintain bug list for developers
Worked with the business to understand and capture business requirements
Work with Customers during User Acceptance Testing to validate web applications and interface with developers to address issues
Worked with SRS 2008 to replicate multiple Foxpro reports
Developed web applications using C#.net, Visual Studio 2008, MVC Framework 1.0, Link2Sql, Subversion, SQL Server 2008, TeamCity, XML

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Established in 1947 as a designer and manufacturer of electronic industrial-safety products, Preco Electronics has evolved into a diversified organization that serves a broad base of customers in construction, mining, municipality, utility, service, waste and many other industries domestically and internationally.

As an Software Development Engineer, my responsibilities are:

Developing customer driven applications in an agile development atmosphere. 
Maintaining the web application and continually refactoring it for better performance and maintainability.
Working internally with hardware developers to capture and maintain customer data.
Working with external partners to create synergy and additional benefits for the customer. 
Continual research and development around new technologies to bring their benefit to our customers.
Developed using C# .Net, Visual Studio 2008, Subsonic ORM, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MS SQL 2005, Subversion, ADO.Net

positions.title: Enterprise Application Architect
positions.description:
SuperValu is a leader in the grocery retailing industry. SuperValu combines expertise in grocery retail and supply chain operations. 

As an Enterprise Application Architect, my responsibilities were:

Maintaining standards and best practices in application development.
Maintaining standards and Best Practices in enterprise application integration.
Creating and maintaining an application portfolio of systems by functional and subject areas.
Creating and maintaining a patterns catalog.
Development of high-level designs of system integrations.
Development of technical use cases.
Worked with the business to understand and document requirements
Continual research into technologies around enterprise application architecture.
Worked with Tibco, Weblogic Integration developers to integrate systems into the current Oracle DB, WLI Service Backbone

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description:
Albertsons was an industry leader in the grocery retailing industry. Albertsons was also a leader in acquiring and implementing new technologies in both their retail and support functions

As an Application Architect, my responsibilities were:

Maintaining standards and best practices in application development.
Maintaining standards and best practices in enterprise application integration.
Development of high-level designs.
Development of detailed designs.
Worked with the business to understand and document requirements
Worked with Tibco, Weblogic Integration developers to integrate systems into the current Oracle DB, WLI Service Backbone
Tools used for the job, Weblogic Workshop, Enterprise Architect, Tibco Business Works

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a Developer, my responsibilities were:

Systems integration.
Development of graphical user interfaces.
Development and maintenance of purchasing and warehousing system.
Tools used for the job, Weblogic Workshop, Oracle DB, Access97, Visual Studio, Visual Basic 6, VBA, Java, Classic ASP, HTML, XML, VBScript, ODBC, ADO

positions.title: Installation Specialist
positions.description:
As an Installation Specialist, my responsibilities were:

Preparation and staging of in*store equipment.
On site installation of store equipment.
On site troubleshooting of store equipment.
